name: Luma Care
title: A clearer path to your next appointment.
summary: A concept for booking medical appointments without losing track of availability, preparation, or follow-up.
audience: People coordinating routine healthcare from their phones.
problem: Booking care often means jumping between provider lists, calendars, and messages. Important preparation instructions get lost along the way.
question: How might we make booking and preparing for a medical appointment feel like one continuous task?
value: Find care. Know what comes next.
description: A guided booking journey brings provider availability, appointment details, and preparation into one place.
insight: Availability should be visible before asking people to commit to a provider.

process.title: Discovery
process.description: Define assumptions and a research plan for people coordinating routine healthcare from their phones.

process.title: Define
process.description: Availability should be visible before asking people to commit to a provider.

process.title: Design
process.description: Map the main journey, compare wireframe alternatives, and develop a coherent visual language.

process.title: Review
process.description: Prepare a usability study to evaluate comprehension, recovery, and task completion. No study results are claimed.

architecture.description: Four connected destinations organize the primary journey. Each step retains context so people can review their choices before continuing.

wireframes.description: Early layouts compare a provider-first path with an availability-first path. The chosen concept keeps the next appointment visible throughout the journey.

screens.description: Illustrative interface compositions for this fictional concept; not screenshots of a released product.

designSystem.description: A compact foundation of clear type, consistent spacing, and reusable controls supports the main journey.
designSystem.typography: Inter for interface text · Playfair Display for editorial headings

closing.title: Designed to make the next step clearer.
closing.description: The concept needs validation with people who book on behalf of family members, especially around permissions and preparation instructions.
closing.credits: Fictional portfolio case study. All narratives, timelines, and interface examples are demo content; no client work or validated research outcomes are implied.
